extraction.notes: Reconciliation taken from the consolidated FFO table (seq 16, S-3); the identical table appears on seq 11 (page 7). Company reports Core FFO only; no AFFO metric in these pages, so affo fields are null. The FFO subtotal and Core FFO subtotal both foot to the printed totals. Diluted shares printed as 66,470,819 and converted to thousands (66,470.819); 305,544/66,470.819 = $4.60 and 254,683/66,470.819 = $3.83, matching reported per-share figures. Casualty loss shown as '-' in 2024, recorded as 0. 'Impairment loss from unconsolidated co-investments' mapped to re_impairment and 'Depreciation attributable to third party ownership and other' mapped to re_depreciation as best fit; these are judgment calls. 'Impairment' is for co-investments, not directly owned depreciable property. Recurring capex not disclosed in these pages.
